Olivia: Quick check — legal wants confirmation on distribution approach for 'weights-only' bundles from open-model partners. Do we use standard marketplace T&Cs or need a separate addendum? cc @Raj @Emily
Raj: Likely an addendum for anything that allows on-prem redistribution. I'll sketch requirements. :writing_hand:
Emily: +1. Must include export control clause, attribution, and anti-rehosting language. I'll flag any model-specific license conflicts.
Sasha: From infra: downloads need SHA256, provenance JSON, and a gated EULA clickthrough. Marketplace needs geoblock and delivery token support.
Alex: Product thought: offer two SKUs (Hosted vs Weights-only). Different pricing and SLAs. Marketing will want embargo windows for co-announces.
Olivia: Good. Action list: Raj draft addendum, Sasha confirm gating & delivery flow, Alex define SKUs & comms cadence. Target internal review by Thu EOD. :calendar:
Raj: I'll post draft Wed noon and add a TL;DR for eng/legal.
legalbot: Added export-checklist v2 to Drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/export-checklist :robot_face:
Sasha: Note for SI partners — they often want on-prem packages. Add clause permitting private deployment but forbidding repackaging/resale.
Emily: Yes — include explicit anti-rehosting, attribution, and indemnity boundary around datasets used for fine-tuning. Will prepare redlines.
Alex: Also confirm partner wants co-announcement. If so, we need embargo, logo usage terms, and a short joint comms plan.
Olivia: I'll sync with Marketing after Raj posts the draft. Thanks everyone — this helps unblock partner onboarding.
